title: The Petiole Doesn't Lie
description: Before you buy, before you pot, before you name it — read the petiole. A collector's guide to what stems reveal about species identity.

description: Inside the obsession of raising equatorial aroids — velvet philodendrons, anthuriums, rare hoyas — in climates that should kill them.
